title: Roja
desc: Roja, a simple girl from a village in Tamil Nadu, makes desperate efforts to find her husband, Rishi, after he is kidnapped by militants during a secret undercover mission in Jammu and Kashmir.

title: Nippu
desc: Surya decides to help his friend, Sriram, who is accused of murdering his girlfriend, Vaishnavi. In order to do so, however, he must deal with Vaishnavi's father and his nemesis, Raja Goud.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.

title: Teddy
desc: Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.

title: Manyam Puli
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Current
desc: Sushanth, a college student, believes in living in the present while Sneha, his girlfriend, believes in planning for the future. Due to their contrasting personalities, they part ways with each other.

title: Fun Time
desc: The programme includes comedy clips from Tollywood movies.

title: Bhoomi
desc: After his daughter is brutally raped and the attackers are acquitted, a father decides to take revenge and bring the perpetrators to justice.

title: Entha Manchivaadavuraa
desc: Balu grows up without the love of a family due to his parents' untimely death. Later, he decides to establish a firm to help people like himself receive the affection they missed out on.

title: The Raja Saab
desc: RajaSaab's search for his estranged grandfather leads him to a haunted mansion. He learns that his grandfather Kanakaraju, an exorcist, has laid a trap to lure him.

title: Yevadu
desc: Satya gets a different face after he is almost killed, but a new face multiplies his problems. His ordeal begins when he leaves the hospital and has to deal with his lover's murderer.

title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
desc: Venky, an unemployed youth, heads to Hyderabad for a marriage ceremony. What seems like a brief vacation gradually turns into something more, when the soon-to-be bride falls for him.

title: Mangalavaaram
desc: Maaya becomes the new sub-inspector of a village gripped by mysterious murders. But as she begins to investigate, she uncovers a web of dark truths and conspiracies.
